<abbr title="Koh-Lanta: The Cursed Tribe">'''''Koh-Lanta: La Tribu Maudite'''''</abbr> is the thirty-first season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''.

After 41 days, [[Thibault Bélanger]] defeated [[Charlotte Rasquin]] in a 9-4 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]].

==Production==
At its back-to-school press conference held this Thursday, June 27, 2024, the TF1 group unveiled the contours of this new edition, named "La Tribu Maudite" ("The Cursed Tribe", translated in English).<ref>https://www.ozap.com/actu/-koh-lanta-la-tribu-maudite-trois-equipes-retour-d-anciens-heros-un-debrief-avec-denis-brogniart-sur-tf1-tout-ce-qu-il-faut-savoir-sur-la-prochaine-saison/644641</ref>

==Twists/Changes==
* '''The Cursed Tribe:''' 
** '''[[Banishment (Koh-Lanta)|Banishment]]:''' Just after the marooning, 22 new castaways competed in a challenge. The last two men and the last two women to finish were banished to a very hostile island and formed a [[tribe]] of their own, the Cursed Tribe.
** '''[[Duel]]:''' Each episode, the members of the tribe that lose the [[Reward Challenge]] have to vote for one of their own to compete in a duel against a member of the Cursed Tribe. To compete in the Duel, the Cursed Tribe member has to find the "Anito" idol. The winner of the duel then joins the tribe that lost the Reward Challenge, and the loser joins the Cursed Tribe.
** '''Individual Immunity Necklaces:''' The winner of each duel goes back to camp with an Individual Immunity Necklace that they can play at any [[Tribal Council]] until the [[merge]].
** '''Final Challenge:''' On Day 13, the four members of the Cursed tribe competed in a challenge. The two winners would enter the main game, both on different tribes, while the two losers would be permanently eliminated, with the twist being disbanded.
** '''Redemption Duel:''' On Day 31, the castaways eliminated at the final ten competed in a duel on the island of the disbanded Cursed Tribe, the winner of which would return immediately to the main game.
* '''[[Returning Players/Koh-Lanta|One Returnee per Tribe]]:''' Two former winners, [[Frédéric Khouvilay]] and [[Ugo Latriche]], returned for another chance to win. At the marooning, they became team captains and created their respective tribes via a [[Schoolyard Pick]].
* '''Impromptu Tribal Council:''' The tribe that loses third [[Immunity Challenge]] has its Tribal Council held immediately after the challenge, at the challenge site.
* '''{{Dab-twist|Tied Destinies}}:''' On Day 28, the ten remaining castaways are divided into five pairs by a rock draw. Until the next Tribal Council, the fate of each contestant is linked to their partner: the challenges are competed by pairs, and the person voted out at Tribal Council causes their partner's demise.
